description: This file defines the JwtTokenService class, providing helper methods to create and validate JWT tokens used for authentication in the application.

classes.name: JwtTokenService
classes.description: Provides methods to generate signed JWT tokens and create token validation parameters for authentication.

methods.name: JwtTokenService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the JWT token service with issuer, audience, and signing key.

methods.name: CreateToken
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT token for a given user, role, and expiration time.

methods.name: CreateValidationParameters
methods.description: Creates token validation parameters matching this service's signing configuration.
